sections.title: Settings

controls.label: Apply settings
controls.description: Apply pending settings and save preferences. Enabled cheats run only for this session. This does not grant items, unlock progression or switch shells immediately.

controls.label: Discard changes
controls.description: Return every pending setting to its applied value. Active cheats are unchanged.

controls.label: Turn off all cheats
controls.description: Stop ongoing cheats and restore the values this extension owns. Newer changes made by the game or another mod are preserved.

sections.description: Edits are drafts until Apply settings. Cheats start off at every launch.

sections.title: Cheats

controls.label: God mode
controls.description: Prevents damage to the current player. Restores the original damage flag when disabled. Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Auto Heal
controls.description: Refills missing health at your selected interval. Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Infinite Resolve
controls.description: Refills missing Resolve once per second. Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Revive shell
controls.description: Ask the game to revive your shell.

controls.label: Heal amount
controls.description: Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Heal
controls.description: Restore the selected amount of health.

controls.label: Resolve amount
controls.description: Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Add Resolve
controls.description: Add the selected amount of Resolve.

controls.label: Health target (%)
controls.description: Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Set health target
controls.description: Reduces health to the selected percentage. Keeps at least one point in the current pool.
controls.confirm: Reduce health to the selected percentage? At least one health point will remain.

controls.label: 100-point shell limits
controls.description: Raise each shell point limit to at least 100 for this session. This does not grant points. Apply settings to enable; disabling restores limits owned by this extension.

controls.label: No ability cooldown
controls.description: Remove cooldowns from your current player abilities. Original cooldown settings return when disabled. Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Perfect parry
controls.description: Requires the Infinite seal. Opens the perfect parry window while that seal remains equipped. Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Perfect block
controls.description: Requires the Tarnished seal. Enables perfect blocking while that seal remains equipped. Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Perfect harden
controls.description: Requires the Vatra seal. Enables perfect hardening while that seal remains equipped. Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

sections.description: Reversible while enabled. Turn off all cheats restores what the menu owns.

sections.title: Character

controls.label: Auto Heal strength (%)
controls.description: Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Auto Heal interval (seconds)
controls.description: Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Movement multiplier
controls.description: Changes walking, jogging and sprinting speeds. Disable it before changing gameplay shells. Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Movement speed
controls.description: Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Game speed
controls.description: Scales the whole game clock: player, enemies, cutscenes and elevators all at once, so it stays fair. This is separate from Movement multiplier, which only changes your own character. Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Game speed
controls.description: 1.0 is normal. Below 1 is slow motion, above 1 is faster, and 0 freezes the world clock. Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Harbinger level
controls.description: Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Set Harbinger level
controls.description: Uses the level shown in the game UI.
controls.confirm: This changes progression and can trigger achievements. The game may save the changes. Continue?

sections.description: Healing cadence and movement. Movement speeds are restored when disabled.

sections.title: Shells

controls.label: Gameplay shell

options.label: Open this page in a loaded world

controls.description: Changes the actual shell and its abilities. Use CSS for appearance-only changes.

controls.label: Switch gameplay shell
controls.description: Closes Inventory, sends one shell request and checks the result. Active cheats must be disabled first.
controls.confirm: Change your gameplay shell and abilities? Inventory will close. CSS appearance-only changes use the CSS tab.

controls.label: Genessa persistent clones
controls.description: Creates two clones after Apply settings and leaving the menu. Existing game clones are preserved. Requires Genessa's gameplay abilities.

controls.label: Smert fight stance
controls.description: Keeps Smert's weapons drawn through his stance ability. Apply settings, then leave the menu. An existing stance is not taken over.

controls.label: Lazlo repeating shockwave
controls.description: Requires Lazlo's Temperament upgrade. Repeats its detonation during gameplay, stopping in menus, while unfocused or while input is restricted. Apply settings to enable.

controls.label: Shockwave interval (seconds)
controls.description: Apply settings to change the interval. Returning from a menu starts a full interval; missed shots are not replayed.

sections.description: Shell switch is a save change. Powers need the matching gameplay shell.

sections.title: Items

controls.label: Refresh pickup list
controls.description: Read available pickups from the game catalog. No items are added or removed.

controls.label: Pickup
controls.description: Search by item name. Select the item, set an amount and apply settings before adding or removing it.

controls.label: Pickup amount
controls.description: The quantity to add or remove. Edit here, then use Settings > Apply settings.

controls.label: Add selected pickup
controls.description: Add the selected quantity of this pickup.
controls.confirm: Add this pickup and quantity? The game can save the change.

controls.label: Remove selected pickup
controls.description: Remove the selected quantity through the game item system.
controls.confirm: Remove this pickup and quantity? This cannot be undone here.

controls.label: Give all pickups
controls.description: Use the game command to add every pickup.
controls.confirm: Add every pickup? The game can save the changes. This cannot be undone here.

sections.description: Inventory changes are saved by the game.

sections.title: Tarstones

controls.label: Refresh Tarstone list
controls.description: Read available Tarstones and their in-game names. No inventory changes.

controls.label: Tarstone
controls.description: Search the game catalog by name and category.

controls.label: Add selected Tarstone
controls.description: Add an unowned Tarstone. Owned stones keep their level and experience.
controls.confirm: Add this Tarstone? The game can save the change.

controls.label: Give all melee Tarstones
controls.description: Run the game grant command for this category.
controls.confirm: Give every melee Tarstone? The game can save the changes. This cannot be undone here.

controls.label: Give all sidearm Tarstones

controls.confirm: Give every sidearm Tarstone? The game can save the changes. This cannot be undone here.

controls.confirm: Give every support Tarstone? The game can save the changes. This cannot be undone here.

controls.label: Level scope
controls.description: Choose which owned Tarstones to edit. This does not grant missing stones.

controls.label: Target level
controls.description: Edit the target level, then use Settings > Apply settings. Existing experience, durability and stacks are preserved.

controls.label: Set Tarstone levels
controls.description: Update both save-data copies and equipped Tarstones. Only existing entries are changed. Stale data stops the edit.
controls.confirm: Change the selected owned Tarstones to this level? The game can save the change.

sections.description: Ownership and levels are saved by the game.

controls.label: Check completed-intro lock
controls.description: Checks only the verified Egg Stranding lock after the intro is complete. All required tags, the active ability, its effect and a clear animation state must match for nine consecutive checks. Other story or combat locks are left alone. Results are logged by CSSX.
controls.confirm: Check for the known completed-intro lock and call the game cleanup only if every safety check passes? No progression flags or arbitrary tags will be changed.

controls.label: Cancel check
controls.description: Cancel the pending observation. A cleanup that has already run cannot be undone.
